passages.text: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath, and don’t give place to the devil.
passages.note: anger that is not let fester

passages.text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
passages.note: speaking kindly, words that build up

passages.text: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice. And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
